framework_name: FDA Section 524B Premarket Cybersecurity — Security Control Categories
source: Paraphrased from the FDA final guidance "Cybersecurity in Medical Devices: Quality Management System Considerations and Content of Premarket Submissions" (Feb 3, 2026 edition), Section V.B.1, which enumerates these eight security control categories (Appendix 1 details the per-category recommendations). Implements the cybersecurity expectations of FD&C Act Section 524B (21 U.S.C. 360n-2), "Ensuring cybersecurity of devices," added by Section 3305 of the Food and Drug Omnibus Reform Act of 2022 (FDORA), Pub. L. 117-328, effective March 29, 2023 — which requires cyber-device premarket submissions to include a vulnerability-management plan, secure-by-design processes covering updates and patches, and a software bill of materials (SBOM). U.S. Government work, not subject to copyright (17 U.S.C. 105); category names reproduced verbatim, characterizations written in Evidentia's own words.
families: FDA §524B Premarket Cybersecurity Security Control Categories

controls.title: Authentication
controls.description: Verifies the claimed identity of a user, process, or device before granting it access to the device or its functions.
controls.family: FDA §524B Premarket Cybersecurity Security Control Categories

controls.title: Authorization
controls.description: Enforces what an authenticated entity is permitted to do, restricting actions and resource access to those granted by its assigned privileges.
controls.family: FDA §524B Premarket Cybersecurity Security Control Categories

controls.title: Cryptography
controls.description: Applies cryptographic methods and sound key management to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity of data at rest and in transit.
controls.family: FDA §524B Premarket Cybersecurity Security Control Categories

controls.title: Code, Data, and Execution Integrity
controls.description: Ensures that device code, stored data, and the execution environment remain unaltered and trustworthy, detecting and preventing unauthorized or unexpected modification.
controls.family: FDA §524B Premarket Cybersecurity Security Control Categories

controls.title: Confidentiality
controls.description: Protects sensitive data handled by the device from disclosure to unauthorized parties.
controls.family: FDA §524B Premarket Cybersecurity Security Control Categories

controls.title: Event Detection and Logging
controls.description: Detects security-relevant events and records them in logs that support monitoring, investigation, and forensic review.
controls.family: FDA §524B Premarket Cybersecurity Security Control Categories

controls.title: Resiliency and Recovery
controls.description: Enables the device to withstand cybersecurity events and to restore safe, essential operation afterward.
controls.family: FDA §524B Premarket Cybersecurity Security Control Categories

controls.title: Updatability and Patchability
controls.description: Allows the device to be securely updated and patched over its lifecycle so vulnerabilities can be remediated; the guidance's Appendix 1 labels this same category "Firmware and Software Updates."
controls.family: FDA §524B Premarket Cybersecurity Security Control Categories
